subject: an owl assembled from stacked rubber stamp layers
pose: slight side lean on a compact wooden base
requested_medium: layered carved rubber and hardwood object
art_direction: 层叠彩色橡胶板拼成矮胖猫头鹰，错落眼盘与硬木底部形成复古而俏皮的实体头像。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Assemble a squat owl from stacked carved rubber stamp layers mounted on a small hardwood base. The rubber layers alternate muted petrol, coral, and cream, with their cut edges visible around the eye discs and wing shapes. Make one eye disc slightly higher and turn the small beak a fraction off center, suggesting bookish amusement. Keep the eyes simple dark circles with one reserved light notch. Render the matte rubber grain, clean carved recesses, and warm wood end grain as distinct textures. Use a pale stone background and a compact three-quarter angle. The owl fills the inner circle of the square, with no printed lettering, ink pad, or extra tools.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
